metadata.title: SSPP Instance - DNS Secure Email (siem.utoronto.ca)
metadata.remarks: Instance SSPP for the siem.utoronto.ca domain, implementing DNS Secure Email as a non-sending domain used for email security telemetry and reporting.

import-profile.remarks: Inherits all normative DNS Secure Email governance, security, and assessment requirements.

system-characteristics.system-description: Non-sending institutional domain used for email security telemetry, including DMARC aggregate reports and TLS transport reports.

props.name: domain-role
props.remarks: This domain is not authorized to send email.

props.name: dmarc-posture
props.remarks: DMARC enforced to prevent spoofing of a non-sending domain.

props.name: spf-posture
props.remarks: No SPF authorization required as the domain does not send email.

props.name: dkim-posture
props.remarks: DKIM is not applicable to non-sending domains.

components.title: SIEM Reporting Domain
components.description: DNS domain providing endpoints for email security telemetry ingestion.

links.text: Inherits DNS Secure Email governance and controls.

components.remarks: The domain receives DMARC aggregate reports (rua) and TLS-RPT telemetry for centralized monitoring and analysis by Information Security.

control-implementation.remarks: DNS Secure Email controls are satisfied through inherited template requirements. Local configuration is limited to DNS records enabling DMARC and TLS reporting endpoints.
